questions.nlq: What is the total color scanning throughput in pages per minute across all products in the store I am responsible for, and which other stores within the same district have a greater total capacity?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The user manages Store_ID = 1 (Miramichi City Mall), which belongs to District_ID = 15
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH store_1_capacity AS (
    SELECT SUM(p.pages_per_minute_color) AS total_capacity
    FROM store_product sp
    JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.product_id
    WHERE sp.Store_ID = 1
),
district_stores AS (
    SELECT s.Store_ID, s.Store_Name, SUM(p.pages_per_minute_color) AS total_capacity
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_product sp ON s.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
    JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.product_id
    JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
    WHERE sd.District_ID = 15
    GROUP BY s.Store_ID, s.Store_Name
)
SELECT CAST(s1.total_capacity AS REAL) AS my_store_total_capacity,
ds.Store_Name
FROM store_1_capacity s1
CROSS JOIN district_stores ds
WHERE ds.total_capacity > s1.total_capacity AND ds.Store_ID != 1;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: A different user manages Store_ID = 3 (Rogersville Village Store), which belongs to District_ID = 11

WITH store_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.Store_ID,
        SUM(p.pages_per_minute_color) AS total_capacity
    FROM store_product sp
    JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.product_id
    GROUP BY sp.Store_ID
)
SELECT st.Store_Name
FROM store_totals st
JOIN store_district sd ON st.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
WHERE sd.District_ID = 11
AND st.Store_ID != 3
AND st.total_capacity > (

    FROM store_totals

questions.nlq: For my store, list the product with the highest pages per minute color for each interface type.

WITH "store_products" AS (
    SELECT "p"."product_id", "p"."product", "p"."interface", "p"."pages_per_minute_color"
    FROM "store_product" "sp"
    JOIN "product" "p" ON "sp"."Product_ID" = "p"."product_id"
    WHERE "sp"."Store_ID" = 2
)
SELECT "product"
FROM (
    SELECT "product",
           "interface",
           "pages_per_minute_color",
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "interface" ORDER BY "pages_per_minute_color" DESC) AS "rn"
    FROM "store_products"

    FROM product p

    JOIN store_product sp ON p.product_id = sp.Product_ID
    GROUP BY p.product_id

    FROM store_product sp
    INNER JOIN QualifiedProducts qp ON sp.Product_ID = qp.product_id
    INNER JOIN store_district sd ON sp.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
    GROUP BY sd.District_ID
),
TopDistrict AS (
    SELECT District_ID, store_count
    FROM DistrictStoreCounts
    ORDER BY store_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

UNION ALL
